  <!-- 牙盘/五通 -->
  <circle cx="560" cy="560" r="18" fill="#3a3f47"/>

  <path d="M470 415 q35 -22 70 0" fill="none" stroke="#2b2f36" stroke-width="12" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <path id="handlebar" d="M700 420 q0 -50 40 -50" fill="none" stroke="#2b2f36" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- 曲柄 + 踏板（JS 驱动） -->
  <line id="crankNear" x1="560" y1="560" x2="615" y2="560" stroke="#3a3f47" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line id="crankFar"  x1="560" y1="560" x2="505" y2="560" stroke="#22262c" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <rect id="pedalNear" x="0" y="-7" width="34" height="14" rx="4" fill="#1c1f24"/>
  <rect id="pedalFar"  x="0" y="-7" width="34" height="14" rx="4" fill="#33383f"/>

<style>
  /* 云漂移 */
  #cloud1 { animation: drift1 9s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
  #cloud2 { animation: drift2 12s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
  @keyframes drift1 { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(70px); } }
  @keyframes drift2 { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-90px); } }
  /* 路面虚线滚动 */
  #roadline { animation: road 1.2s linear infinite; }
  @keyframes road { from { stroke-dashoffset: 0; } to { stroke-dashoffset: -80; } }
  /* 风吹线条 */
  .wind { animation: wind 1.5s ease-out infinite; }
  .wind:nth-of-type(2) { animation-delay: 0.5s; }
  .wind:nth-of-type(3) { animation-delay: 1.0s; }
  @keyframes wind {
    0%   { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(0); }
    30%  { opacity: 0.8; }
    100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-140px); }
  }
  /* 车轮辐条旋转（1.2s 与曲柄同步） */
  .spokes { animation: spin 1.2s linear infinite; }
  @keyframes spin { from { transform: rotate(0deg); } to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
  /* 头 / 尾轻摆 */
  #head { animation: bobHead 2.4s ease-in-out infinite alternate; transform-box:fill-box; transform-origin:600px 395px; }
  @keyframes bobHead { from { transform: rotate(-2deg); } to { transform: rotate(3deg); } }
  #tail { animation: bobTail 2.4s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
  @keyframes bobTail { from { transform: rotate(-4deg); } to { transform: rotate(6deg); } }
</style>

<script>
(function(){
  // ===== 固定锚点 =====
  const CRANK_CENTER = { x: 560, y: 560 };  // 五通中心
  const CRANK_LEN    = 55;                  // 曲柄长
  const HIP          = { x: 545, y: 455 };  // 胯部
  const THIGH_LEN    = 95;
  const SHIN_LEN     = 95;
  const ANKLE_LIFT   = 10;                  // 脚踝=踏板上方10px
  const PERIOD       = 1.2;                 // 秒，与轮子同步

  // 曲柄近端（前腿）/ 远端（后腿）
  const near = {
    crank: document.getElementById('crankNear'),
    pedal: document.getElementById('pedalNear'),
    thigh: document.getElementById('thighNear'),
    shin:  document.getElementById('shinNear'),
    foot:  document.getElementById('footNear')
  };
  const far = {
    crank: document.getElementById('crankFar'),
    pedal: document.getElementById('pedalFar'),
    thigh: document.getElementById('thighFar'),
    shin:  document.getElementById('shinFar'),
    foot:  document.getElementById('footFar')
  };

  // 两圆交点法求膝盖（返回偏向前进方向的解）
  function solveKnee(hip, ankle) {
    let dx = ankle.x - hip.x, dy = ankle.y - hip.y;
    let d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
    const maxD = THIGH_LEN + SHIN_LEN;
    // 夹紧：若踝超出可达范围，按比例收回
    if (d > maxD) {
      const s = maxD / d;
      ankle = { x: hip.x + dx * s, y: hip.y + dy * s };
      dx = ankle.x - hip.x; dy = ankle.y - hip.y; d = maxD;
    }
    // 标准两圆交点：两圆半径 r1=大腿 r2=小腿
    const r1 = THIGH_LEN, r2 = SHIN_LEN;
    let a = (r1*r1 - r2*r2) / (2*d);
    let h2 = r1*r1 - a*a;
    if (h2 < 0) h2 = 0;
    const h = Math.sqrt(h2);
    const mx = hip.x + a*dx/d, my = hip.y + a*dy/d;
    // 两个交点，取 x 更大（膝盖朝前）的那个
    const k1 = { x: mx + h*dy/d, y: my - h*dx/d };
    const k2 = { x: mx - h*dy/d, y: my + h*dx/d };
    return (k1.x >= k2.x) ? k1 : k2;
  }

  function setLine(el, x1, y1, x2, y2) {
    el.setAttribute('x1', x1); el.setAttribute('y1', y1);
    el.setAttribute('x2', x2); el.setAttribute('y2', y2);
  }
  function setPedal(el, x, y) {
    el.setAttribute('x', x - 17); el.setAttribute('y', y - 7);
  }
  // 脚掌：一个朝前的小三角形，锚在脚踝
  function setFoot(el, ax, ay) {
    el.setAttribute('d', `M${ax-6} ${ay} L${ax+16} ${ay+6} L${ax-4} ${ay+12} Z`);
  }

  // 驱动一条腿：给定曲柄角
  function driveLeg(L, theta) {
    const px = CRANK_CENTER.x + CRANK_LEN * Math.cos(theta);
    const py = CRANK_CENTER.y + CRANK_LEN * Math.sin(theta);
    // 曲柄
    setLine(L.crank, CRANK_CENTER.x, CRANK_CENTER.y, px, py);
    // 踏板
    setPedal(L.pedal, px, py);
    // 脚踝 = 踏板上方10px
    const ankle = { x: px, y: py - ANKLE_LIFT };
    // 膝盖（两圆交点）
    const knee = solveKnee(HIP, ankle);
    // 大腿 / 小腿
    setLine(L.thigh, HIP.x, HIP.y, knee.x, knee.y);
    setLine(L.shin,  knee.x, knee.y, ankle.x, ankle.y);
    // 脚
    setFoot(L.foot, ankle.x, ankle.y);
  }

  let start = null;
  function frame(ts) {
    if (start === null) start = ts;
    const t = (ts - start) / 1000;
    const theta = (t / PERIOD) * Math.PI * 2;   // 匀速增大
    driveLeg(near, theta);
    driveLeg(far, theta + Math.PI);            // 远腿相差180°
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
